verdict.rationale: Riveter scrapes and extracts web data, so a selector-based extraction story applies to it. The evidence documents only AI-agent interpretation of pages and URL-to-text scraping; nothing shows user-defined CSS or XPath selector rules. Its docs present the AI approach as an alternative to fixed page configurations, which is not the selector capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract specific fields from a page using CSS or XPath selector rules
